all <- merge(all, race_added, by = "study_id", all.x = TRUE)

all <- all %>%
  mutate(
    type_of_aki = case_when(
      final_type_of_aki == 1 ~ "Prerenal",
      final_type_of_aki == 2 ~ "HRS-AKI",
      final_type_of_aki == 3 ~ "ATN",
      final_type_of_aki == 4 ~ "Other",
      final_type_of_aki == 5 ~ "Unable to diagnosis"),
    etiology_cirrhosis = case_when(
      etiology_cirrhosis == 1 ~ "Alcohol",
      etiology_cirrhosis == 2 ~ "Hepatitis C",
      etiology_cirrhosis == 3 ~ "MASLD",
      etiology_cirrhosis == 5 ~ "Multifactorial",
      etiology_cirrhosis %in% c(4, 6, 7) ~ "Other"),
    race_cat_4 = case_when(
      ethnicity == 2 & race == 5 ~ "NHW",
      ethnicity == 1 & race == 5 ~ "HW",
      ethnicity %in% c(1, 2) & race == 3 ~ "Black",
      ethnicity %in% c(1, 2) & race %in% c(1, 2, 4, 6) ~ "NWNB"),
    race = case_when(
      race == 1 ~ "American Indian or Alaska Native",
      race == 2 ~ "Asian",
      race == 3 ~ "Black or African American",
      race == 4 ~ "Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander",
      race == 5 ~ "White",
      race == 6 ~ "Other",
      race == 7 ~ "Unknown"),
    ethnicity = ifelse(ethnicity == 1, "Hispanic",
                ifelse(ethnicity == 2, "Non-Hispanic", "Unknown")),
    female = ifelse(sex == 2, 1, 0)
  )

calculate_meld3 <- function(female, bilirubin, sodium, inr, creatinine, albumin) {
  if (anyNA(c(female, bilirubin, sodium, inr, creatinine, albumin)) ||
      any(c(bilirubin, sodium, inr, creatinine, albumin) <= 0)) return(NA)
  1.33 * female + 4.56 * log(bilirubin) +
    0.82 * (137 - sodium) - 0.24 * (137 - sodium) * log(bilirubin) +
    9.09 * log(inr) + 11.14 * log(creatinine) +
    1.85 * (3.5 - albumin) - 1.83 * (3.5 - albumin) * log(creatinine) + 6
}

all <- all %>%
  mutate(meld_3 = mapply(calculate_meld3,
                         female, tb_admit, na_admit, inr_admit,
                         creatinine_admission, alb_admit))

n1 <- nrow(step1)

  mutate(MELD_Na_baseline = replace_na(MELD_Na_baseline, median(MELD_Na_baseline, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  filter(MELD_Na_baseline >= 0)
n3 <- nrow(step3)

step4 <- step3 %>% filter(!is.na(meld_3))
n4 <- nrow(step4)

adjuster_vars <- c("age_admission", "etiology_cirrhosis", "hcc_admission",
                    "diabetes", "cad", "ckd", "htn", "site")
comorb_detail <- sapply(adjuster_vars, function(v) sum(is.na(step4[[v]])))

master <- step4 %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(adjuster_vars), ~ !is.na(.)))
n5 <- nrow(master)

cat_var <- c("sex", "race_cat_4", "etiology_cirrhosis", "hcc_admission",
             "diabetes", "cad", "ckd", "htn", "site",
             "ascites_admission", "encephalopathy_admission",
             "type_of_aki", "aclf_grade", "status_90days")
for (v in intersect(cat_var, names(master))) master[[v]] <- as.factor(master[[v]])

master$race_cat_4 <- relevel(master$race_cat_4, ref = "NHW")
master$etiology_cirrhosis <- relevel(master$etiology_cirrhosis, ref = "Alcohol")

title: Revision
text:
Mediation Analysis — LT-Listing as Mediator
Question: How much of the association between Black race (vs. non-Black) and 90-day mortality is mediated through listing for liver transplant?
Causal model:
Black race  ──(direct, NDE)──────▶  90-day death
     │                                    ▲
     └──▶  LT listed  ──(indirect, NIE)───┘
Method: CMAverse::cmest() regression-based estimator with exposure–mediator interaction. Exposure = Black (1) vs. non-Black (0); Mediator = liver_transplant_listed (binary); Outcome = 90-day mortality via Cox proportional hazards (cause-specific — liver transplant censored, the standard mediation framing when a competing event is itself the hypothesized mediator’s downstream effect). Confounders adjusted: age, MELD 3.0, etiology, HCC, diabetes, CAD, CKD, HTN, site. 95% CIs via 500 bootstrap replicates.
Key assumptions: no unmeasured exposure–outcome, exposure–mediator, or mediator–outcome confounding conditional on measured covariates; consistency; positivity.


Show code
library(CMAverse)

med_confounders <- c("age_admission", "meld_3", "etiology_cirrhosis",
                     "hcc_admission", "diabetes", "cad", "ckd", "htn", "site")

make_med_dat <- function(d) {
  num01 <- function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x))
  out <- d %>%
    filter(!is.na(liver_transplant_listed)) %>%
    mutate(
      black         = as.numeric(race_cat_4 == "Black"),
      lt_listed     = num01(liver_transplant_listed),
      death         = num01(status_90days),
      time          = as.numeric(time_90days),
      age_admission = as.numeric(age_admission),
      meld_3        = as.numeric(meld_3),
      hcc_admission = num01(hcc_admission),
      diabetes      = num01(diabetes),
      cad           = num01(cad),
      ckd           = num01(ckd),
      htn           = num01(htn),
      etiology_cirrhosis = factor(as.character(etiology_cirrhosis)),
      site          = factor(as.character(site))
    ) %>%
    select(all_of(c("black", "lt_listed", "death", "time", med_confounders))) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na() %>%
    filter(time > 0) %>%
    droplevels()
  as.data.frame(out)
}

run_mediation <- function(dat, label) {
  set.seed(42)
  fit <- cmest(
    data       = dat,
    model      = "rb",
    outcome    = "time",
    event      = "death",
    exposure   = "black",
    mediator   = "lt_listed",
    basec      = med_confounders,
    EMint      = TRUE,
    mreg       = list("logistic"),
    yreg       = "coxph",
    astar      = 0,
    a          = 1,
    mval       = list(0),
    estimation = "imputation",
    inference  = "bootstrap",

title: Revision
text:
Mediation Analysis — LT-Listing as Mediator (Fine-Gray)
Question: How much of the association between Black race (vs. non-Black) and 90-day mortality is mediated through listing for liver transplant?
Causal model:
Black race  ──(direct, NDE)──────▶  90-day death
     │                                    ▲
     └──▶  LT listed  ──(indirect, NIE)───┘
Method: G-computation–based mediation using a Fine-Gray sub-distribution hazard model (cmprsk::crr) with liver transplant as the competing event. Exposure = Black (1) vs. non-Black (0); Mediator = liver_transplant_listed (binary); Outcome = cumulative incidence of death at 90 days. Confounders adjusted: age, MELD 3.0, etiology, HCC, diabetes, CAD, CKD, HTN, site.
Effects reported on the risk-difference scale (CIF at day 90, percentage points):

TE (total effect) = CIF(Black, M=M(Black)) − CIF(non-Black, M=M(non-Black))
NDE (natural direct) = CIF(Black, M=M(non-Black)) − CIF(non-Black, M=M(non-Black))
NIE (natural indirect, through LT-listing) = CIF(Black, M=M(Black)) − CIF(Black, M=M(non-Black))
pm (proportion mediated) = NIE / TE

95% CIs via 500 bootstrap replicates.
Key assumptions: no unmeasured exposure–outcome, exposure–mediator, or mediator–outcome confounding conditional on measured covariates; consistency; positivity.


Show code
library(cmprsk)

med_confounders <- c("age_admission", "meld_3", "etiology_cirrhosis",
                     "hcc_admission", "diabetes", "cad", "ckd", "htn", "site")

make_med_dat <- function(d) {
  num01 <- function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x))
  out <- d %>%
    filter(!is.na(liver_transplant_listed)) %>%
    mutate(
      black         = as.numeric(race_cat_4 == "Black"),
      lt_listed     = num01(liver_transplant_listed),
      death         = num01(status_90days),
      time          = as.numeric(time_90days),
      age_admission = as.numeric(age_admission),
      meld_3        = as.numeric(meld_3),
      hcc_admission = num01(hcc_admission),
      diabetes      = num01(diabetes),
      cad           = num01(cad),
      ckd           = num01(ckd),
      htn           = num01(htn),
      etiology_cirrhosis = factor(as.character(etiology_cirrhosis)),
      site          = factor(as.character(site))
    ) %>%
    select(all_of(c("black", "lt_listed", "death", "time", med_confounders))) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na() %>%
    filter(time > 0) %>%
    droplevels()
  as.data.frame(out)
}

# Build design matrix for FG outcome model (exposure, mediator, interaction, confounders)
build_x <- function(d) {
  model.matrix(
    ~ black * lt_listed + age_admission + meld_3 + etiology_cirrhosis +
      hcc_admission + diabetes + cad + ckd + htn + site,
    data = d
  )[, -1, drop = FALSE]
}

# Predicted CIF at a given time from a crr fit, averaged over the data distribution
cif_at_t <- function(crr_fit, d_counter, t_eval = 90) {
  x_new <- build_x(d_counter)
  # cmprsk::predict.crr returns matrix: first col = time, rest = CIF per row of x_new
  pred <- predict(crr_fit, cov1 = x_new)
  times <- pred[, 1]
  # Find index of last time <= t_eval
  idx_t <- suppressWarnings(max(which(times <= t_eval)))
  if (!is.finite(idx_t) || idx_t < 1) idx_t <- 1
  cif_row <- pred[idx_t, -1]
  mean(cif_row)
}

# One mediation computation given a dataset (no bootstrap)
compute_effects <- function(d, t_eval = 90) {
  # Mediator model
  m_form <- lt_listed ~ black + age_admission + meld_3 + etiology_cirrhosis +
    hcc_admission + diabetes + cad + ckd + htn + site
  m_mod <- glm(m_form, data = d, family = binomial())

  # FG outcome model
  x <- build_x(d)
  fg <- crr(ftime = d$time, fstatus = d$death, cov1 = x,
            failcode = 1, cencode = 0)

  # For each exposure value a, draw M from its predicted distribution
  simulate_M <- function(a_val) {
    d_a <- d; d_a$black <- a_val
    p_m <- predict(m_mod, newdata = d_a, type = "response")
    rbinom(nrow(d), 1, p_m)
  }

  set.seed(2024)
  M0 <- simulate_M(0)  # M under non-Black
  M1 <- simulate_M(1)  # M under Black

  # Counterfactual datasets
  d_a0_m0 <- d; d_a0_m0$black <- 0; d_a0_m0$lt_listed <- M0
  d_a1_m0 <- d; d_a1_m0$black <- 1; d_a1_m0$lt_listed <- M0
  d_a1_m1 <- d; d_a1_m1$black <- 1; d_a1_m1$lt_listed <- M1

  CIF_a0_m0 <- cif_at_t(fg, d_a0_m0, t_eval)
  CIF_a1_m0 <- cif_at_t(fg, d_a1_m0, t_eval)
  CIF_a1_m1 <- cif_at_t(fg, d_a1_m1, t_eval)

  NDE <- CIF_a1_m0 - CIF_a0_m0
  NIE <- CIF_a1_m1 - CIF_a1_m0
  TE  <- CIF_a1_m1 - CIF_a0_m0
  pm  <- ifelse(abs(TE) < 1e-8, NA_real_, NIE / TE)

  c(NDE = NDE, NIE = NIE, TE = TE, pm = pm,
    CIF_nonBlack = CIF_a0_m0, CIF_Black = CIF_a1_m1)
}

run_fg_mediation <- function(dat, label, nboot = 500, t_eval = 90) {
  # Point estimate
  pe <- compute_effects(dat, t_eval)

  # Bootstrap
  set.seed(42)
  boot_mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = nboot, ncol = length(pe),
                     dimnames = list(NULL, names(pe)))
  for (b in seq_len(nboot)) {
    idx <- sample.int(nrow(dat), replace = TRUE)
    eff <- tryCatch(compute_effects(dat[idx, , drop = FALSE], t_eval),
                    error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(pe)))
    boot_mat[b, ] <- eff
  }

  ci_low  <- apply(boot_mat, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
  ci_high <- apply(boot_mat, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  # Two-sided p-value via bootstrap (for effects only, not pm/CIF)
  pvals <- sapply(names(pe), function(nm) {
    if (nm %in% c("pm", "CIF_nonBlack", "CIF_Black")) return(NA_real_)
    bv <- boot_mat[, nm]
    bv <- bv[is.finite(bv)]
    if (length(bv) < 10) return(NA_real_)
    2 * min(mean(bv >= 0), mean(bv <= 0))
  })

  list(label = label, n = nrow(dat), t_eval = t_eval,
       pe = pe, ci_low = ci_low, ci_high = ci_high, p = pvals)
}

format_fg_med <- function(res) {
  scale_pct <- function(x) x * 100
  out <- tibble(
    Effect = c("TE", "NDE", "NIE", "pm"),
    Meaning = c(
      "Total effect (risk difference at 90d, percentage points)",
      "Natural direct effect (not through LT-listing)",
      "Natural indirect effect (through LT-listing)",
      "Proportion mediated"
    ),
    Estimate = c(
      sprintf("%.1f", scale_pct(res$pe["TE"])),
      sprintf("%.1f", scale_pct(res$pe["NDE"])),
      sprintf("%.1f", scale_pct(res$pe["NIE"])),
      sprintf("%.2f", res$pe["pm"])
    ),
    `95% CI` = c(
      sprintf("%.1f, %.1f", scale_pct(res$ci_low["TE"]),  scale_pct(res$ci_high["TE"])),
      sprintf("%.1f, %.1f", scale_pct(res$ci_low["NDE"]), scale_pct(res$ci_high["NDE"])),
      sprintf("%.1f, %.1f", scale_pct(res$ci_low["NIE"]), scale_pct(res$ci_high["NIE"])),
      sprintf("%.2f, %.2f", res$ci_low["pm"],  res$ci_high["pm"])
    ),
    p = c(
      style_pvalue(res$p["TE"],  digits = 3),
      style_pvalue(res$p["NDE"], digits = 3),
      style_pvalue(res$p["NIE"], digits = 3),
      ""
    )
  )
  out
}
